posts.text: I'm not as cracked as Rainbolt on GeoGuessr... but as a third-year student, I think I know Western's campus pretty well (ignore my score). So I built UwoGuessr - a GeoGuessr inspired game made just for our campus. In UwoGuessr, you can: - Compete for the top daily score in the Daily Challenge - Upload your own campus photos - Finally figure out how to get to North Campus Building Feel free to try it out and reach out with any feedback or suggestions. 👉 https://www.uwoguessr.com/ Inspired by MacG
